Faculty Review: PNg | MAT250 + MAT350 | Summer 2024 & Spring 2025
Full Name: Dr. Preetom Nag

Calculus এর ব্যাসিক আমাকে স্ট্রং করে দিয়েছিলো MAT120 তে CNP স্যার। কিন্তু MAT130 তে বেশ গ্যাপ থাকায় MAT250 & MAT350 তে ভালোই প্যারা খাওয়া লেগেছিলো, কারন Mid এর পর বেশিরভাগ জিনিসই ছিলো Integration, uv or u/v method, sin cos , lnx etc etc...। কিন্তু PNg স্যার এতো ভালোভাবে সবকিছু ধরে ধরে বুঝায় দিতো বলার বাইরে। MAT250 র ম্যাথগুলো আমি বুঝতাম কিন্তু সমস্যা হয়ে যেতো নরমাল Integration এর ক্যালকুলেশন গুলায় 
 একদমই পারতাম না, পাশের বন্ধুর থেকে U/V কিভাবে হলো, Sin Theta র Integration মাইনাস Cos Theta কিভাবে হলো এগুলা জিজ্ঞেস করেই সেমিস্টার কাটায় দিতে হতো আমার।

text:
Faculty Review: Fdw
Course: MAT250
Before starting the course there was not a single review which indicated how he actually is. Most of the reviews are negative and very few were kind of positive. Also, the scary part was after revealing the faculty initial. Out of 40 registered students almost 18 either dropped or changed the section. It was really very scary, "What can be the reason? Is he too bad?". From the very beginning he was helpful. He would start taking the class on time and finish at least 20-30 minutes early. He would keep the remaining time to discuss any problems from the previous exercises or chapters. He would complete almost all the problems in that exercise during class and also give some of the similar problems as homework. But he would expect you to have a very good grip over MAT130. So, remember that if you did MAT130 a long time ago, you must do some revision before starting his course. But there is nothing to worry about, he will explain you the topic in details if you just ask him once. But keep in mind that you will not get extra office hours from him. You need to clear all the confusions within the class time. He is available anytime if anybody calls, but will not reply much through email. Till the previous semester (Fall 2020) he would take 4 quizzes and count all of them. But in the last semester (Spring 2021) he counted 3 out of 4 for our convenience. The TA was also quite liberal. There was no mid and final term examination but assignments. The assignment problems will be lengthy and a bit time consuming to understand but can be solved. There were 2 viva in one of which he will ask you to solve a problem from your favorite topic. Even if you are unable to solve it he will give you not less than 75% marks if you could at least tell him the steps to do it. And the other viva will be according to his choice. He will give you very basic problems to solve during the viva but you need to know all the basic concepts for that. There was another assignment in which he wanted to check all the problems that he gave as practice/homework problems from all the chapters. He will not curve a lot. But it is very easy to score good during the quizzes. The questions will be easy and can be solved if anyone stays attentive in class and completes the home works. Nobody failed in our section rather got quite good grades.
I would like to share according to my past experience that, reviews don't actually go well for online classes. I had bad experience with someone who had great reviews and good experience with someone whose reviews were bad. So, make your choices accordingly.
Good Luck.
